name: mean-variance-optimizer
description: Portfolio optimization using mean-variance analysis. Calculate tangency portfolios and minimum variance portfolios.
long_description: This extension provides portfolio optimization tools based on modern portfolio theory. It can calculate the tangency (maximum Sharpe ratio) portfolio and the minimum variance portfolio given asset statistics. Uses numpy for efficient matrix calculations.

tools.name: calculate_tangency_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate the tangency (maximum Sharpe ratio) portfolio
